t05.desc: Clean appliance interiors/exteriors as appropriate; unplug toaster first.

t12.desc: Clear items and vacuum/sweep the stairs.

t14.desc: Clean toilet, sink and counter; tidy up, all bathroom mirrors, and replace toilet paper.

t17.desc: Take household bins to the appropriate collection area.

t18.desc: Empty garbage bins throughout the house and replace liners as needed.

t19.desc: Load dirty dishes and start it if appropriate & Unload the dishwasher.

t23.desc: Clean accessible windows and focus on the sliding glass door.

t25.desc: Clear snow from agreed paths and entrance.

t26.desc: Mow lawn when needed and conditions allow.
